requirements.requirement: The system must transform raw prescription behavior input into a structured display model conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must normalize prescribing pattern values (e.g., percentages, counts) into consistent numeric formats suitable for UI rendering.
The system must map clinical condition identifiers from input data to human-readable condition labels using the defined schema contract.
The system must calculate each prescription behavior metric’s relative contribution to the overall quality score as a normalized value between 0 and 1 or 0 and 100%.
The system must preserve ordering of prescription behavior items based on contribution or importance as defined by the schema.
The system must output display-ready text or structured content compatible with MessageBubble.tsx rendering expectations.
The system must round or format numeric values (e.g., percentages) to a consistent precision suitable for UI display.
The system must handle multiple prescription behavior entries in a single input and produce a corresponding list of display-ready items.
The system must exclude or flag prescription entries that do not meet minimum data completeness thresholds defined in the schema.
The system must produce deterministic outputs such that identical inputs always result in identical transformed display structures.
The system must return an empty but valid display structure when prescription behavior input data is empty.
The system must gracefully handle missing condition mappings by substituting a default label such as "Unknown condition" without failing the transformation.
The system must validate input data against the schema from EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1 before transformation and reject or flag invalid structures.
The system must ensure that the sum of relative contribution values does not exceed 100% (or normalized equivalent) after transformation.
